label: Debit Card
title: Debit Card
summary: Use a Debit Card to show a card the user already holds: its bank, type, last four digits, cardholder, and expiry.
corePrinciple: The card in their wallet, never the full number.

configuration.title: Type, logo, art, and brand
configuration.description: cardType is free text: write Debit or Credit, and nothing else changes. bankLogoSlot puts your bank’s mark before its name, and providerLogoSlot puts a network mark after the type; the package ships neither. The art strip is the package’s own: cardArtSource replaces it with your picture, and showArt={false} removes it while the card keeps its 224 px. The DebitCard brand mode colours the card: JFS gold with dark text by default, or SBI purple with white text. No other mode changes it.

states.title: A picture, or a button
states.description: Without onPress the card is a picture: it doesn’t press, and screen readers read its text. onPress makes the whole card one button, named by its bank, type, and number unless you set accessibilityLabel. A pressable card dims while pressed, and disabled stops it and dims it to half. The card doesn’t flip, freeze, or show a CVV.

sizing.title: Always 328 × 224
sizing.description: The card is a fixed 328 × 224, as in Figma, and doesn’t grow or shrink with its host or its text. The top band has 16 px of padding above and 28 px below; the art strip is 50 px tall; the details sit 16 px apart with 20 px at the sides. The top band is 73 px with or without a 29 px bank logo; a taller logo makes it taller.

content.title: Masked, short, as printed
content.description: Write bankName as the issuer and cardType as Debit or Credit. Mask cardNumber to its last four digits, and write expireDate as MM/YY. Give cardholderName as it appears on the card. When the card presses, set accessibilityLabel to the type, bank, and last four, such as Debit card, JioFinance, ending 4821, never the full number.

sources.title: Use the public Debit Card contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (27 October build of Biscuit’s main) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s Debit Card exposes cardholderName, cardNumber, and expireDate; its bank and network logos are nested instances, and its brand is a variable mode. The package ships no logos; the top band keeps Figma’s 73 px without one. On the SBI brand the text is white. cardArtSource replaces the art strip and showArt= removes it, though the art doesn’t change with the brand. Long bank or type text ends in an ellipsis, and a pressable card dims while pressed. Every published Storybook story renders the card as a button, and the published page is the older generated one (all reported).
